name: DMS AI Agent
author: Cha1000000 (fork of Francisdelca/dms-agent)
description: AI desktop assistant powered by Claude Code: chat panel that controls your desktop in natural language, with live tool progress, local voice input (Whisper), model and effort selection from the CLI, conversation history, and a per-monitor chat you can drag between screens. Tool calls ask for confirmation by default; an optional autonomous mode runs them without asking.
